description: Slices an STL file on this computer into G-code on Melt3D's servers and writes the G-code to a file, in flat layers or in nonplanar conical layers (layers: "conical"), which print overhangs without support. Returns where it was written, whether its layers are conical, the layer count, and the estimated print time and filament. A live API key is billed once per successful slice; failed slices are free.

cone_angle.description: With layers "conical": degrees from horizontal, at least 5 either way (default 15). Positive leans the layers outwards, negative inwards.

layers.description: planar (default), or conical: nonplanar layers that print overhangs without support

model_path.description: Path to the STL file to slice.

output_path.description: Where to write the G-code. Default: beside the model, with the extension .gcode.

name: slice_model
title: Slice a 3D model into G-code
